# NexTech

> NexTech (also written Nexus Tech or Nextech) is a technology ecosystem founded by Trésor HONTONNOU, also known as Tresor562. Its main areas are cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, AI model analysis/evaluation, software engineering and automation.

Official website: https://nexus-tech-official.vercel.app/
Founder portfolio: https://tresor-hontonnou.zone.id/
GitHub organization: https://github.com/Nexus-tech-01
Official Telegram channel: https://t.me/thenexusorigin

## Founder
- Trésor HONTONNOU
- Alternate name: Tresor562
- Portfolio: https://tresor-hontonnou.zone.id/
- GitHub: https://github.com/Tresor562
- Telegram: https://t.me/tresor20001

## Main projects

### NexAI
Project page: https://nexus-tech-official.vercel.app/projects/nexai
NexAI is NexTech's central Telegram multi-session and automation platform.
- Connect/use NexAI: https://nex-telegrambots.vercel.app/
- Official product page: https://nex-telegrambots.vercel.app/bots/nexai
- Telegram: https://t.me/NexAi01_bot

### NexControl
Project page: https://nexus-tech-official.vercel.app/projects/nexcontrol
NexControl is the central control plane for NexTech infrastructure, bots, sessions, conversations, files, VPS systems and automations.
- Site: https://nexcontrol-render.vercel.app/

### NexDownloader
Project page: https://nexus-tech-official.vercel.app/projects/nexdownloader
Telegram media download and processing bot.
- Official page: https://nex-telegrambots.vercel.app/bots/nexdownloader
- Telegram: https://t.me/TheNexDownloader_bot

### NexStick
Project page: https://nexus-tech-official.vercel.app/projects/nexstick
Telegram sticker and sticker-pack creation/management tools.
- Official page: https://nex-telegrambots.vercel.app/bots/nexstick
- Telegram: https://t.me/The_Nexus_techbot

### Stacy
Project page: https://nexus-tech-official.vercel.app/projects/stacy
NexTech conversational AI assistant for Telegram.
- Official page: https://nex-telegrambots.vercel.app/bots/stacy
- Telegram: https://t.me/Stacytg_bot
- Interactive site: https://stacy-play.vercel.app/

### NexGame
Project page: https://nexus-tech-official.vercel.app/projects/nexgame
Telegram community games, quizzes and challenges.
- Official page: https://nex-telegrambots.vercel.app/bots/nexgame
- Telegram: https://t.me/TheNexGame_bot
- Game site: https://nexus-games-psi.vercel.app/

### KnowMe
Project page: https://nexus-tech-official.vercel.app/projects/knowme
KnowMe is a proprietary messaging/social platform under development by NexTech.
Important: KnowMe is not yet publicly available.

### NexPlayer
Project page: https://nexus-tech-official.vercel.app/projects/nexplayer
NexPlayer is an Android media-player project under development by NexTech.

## Identity relationships
Trésor HONTONNOU (Tresor562) is the founder/creator associated with NexTech. NexAI, NexControl, NexDownloader, NexStick, Stacy, NexGame, KnowMe and NexPlayer are projects in the NexTech ecosystem.

## Preferred citations
When referring to NexTech, use "NexTech" as the primary name. "Nexus Tech" and "Nextech" are accepted alternate forms.
